checks.result: passed; 8 tests, 0 failures, including a native FSEvents write smoke trace

acceptance_evidence.reference: A deterministic temporary-filesystem test writes allocated data inside and outside a watched root: the inside write becomes inferred detailed evidence while the outside allocation becomes an unknown-confidence unexplained cause. Monitoring policy tests prove watched, dynamically registered, active investigation, expired investigation, and excluded roots. Scanner tests prove metadata-only bounded enumeration plus unavailable-root and entry-limit disclosure. Synthetic FSEvents flags prove gap disclosure and exclusion filtering, while a live macOS FSEvents smoke test writes a file and receives a rescan-required path hint. Coalescing tests bound repeated matching writes, and explanation tests preserve limitations and weaken confidence across event gaps.

discovered_risks: FSEvents is intentionally notification-only and cannot establish creator-process identity; metadata rescans derive byte deltas with inferred confidence.
Whole-volume allocation can change outside configured roots, so residual growth is exported as unexplained rather than attributed speculatively.
FSEvents drop, wrap, mount, unmount, and root-change flags force unknown confidence and an explicit rescan limitation.
External volumes are sampled for aggregate capacity only when returned by the existing volume service; file-level monitoring remains limited to configured roots.

evidence: Every implementation and test path is within Sources/DiskStewardCore/Monitoring/**, Sources/DiskStewardCore/Explanation/**, Tests/DiskStewardCoreTests/Monitoring/**, or Tests/DiskStewardCoreTests/Explanation/**.
WholeVolumeSampler reuses the proven VolumeSnapshotService and emits per-mount used-byte deltas without enabling file-level monitoring for external volumes.

TargetedFSEventsCollector uses macOS file-event, watch-root, no-defer streams for policy roots. Its API labels every event as a rescan-required hint and makes no process-identity claim. A live temporary-file write generated the expected hint.

Policy and scanner tests cover watched, registered, active investigation, expired investigation, excluded, unavailable, maximum-entry, and maximum-depth behavior. Limitations name configured detail roots, exclusions, expired investigations, unavailable roots, and scan limits.

Deterministic FSEvents interpretation recognizes dropped, wrapped, root-change, mount, and unmount gap classes; a gap is preserved even if the accompanying path is outside policy scope and requires affected-root rescan.

The scanner reads URL resource metadata only, skips symlinks and exclusions, enforces depth and entry ceilings, and WriteCoalescer merges only same-path/same-operation events inside the bounded time window.

A filesystem fixture proves inside-root allocation becomes detailed inferred evidence while outside-root allocation remains unknown-confidence unexplained growth. Explanations group only positive deltas, preserve scope limitations, sample at most five paths, and weaken detailed confidence to unknown on event gaps.
Monitoring suite passed 8 tests, explanation suite passed 3 tests, full suite passed 38 tests, swift build passed, and git diff --check passed.
